content.short: Femplate provides a robust Solidity template for Foundry projects.
content.description: Femplate is a comprehensive Solidity template repository crafted for Foundry projects, offering a ready-to-use set of contracts, patterns, and configurations to accelerate development. It includes scripting utilities, test scaffolds, and a suite of Bash scripts designed to automate common tasks such as compilation, testing, deployment, and project maintenance. With its modular templates and documented workflows, developers can bootstrap new projects quickly, enforce consistent patterns, and focus on business logic while benefiting from established best practices and reusable components.
